blocks.text: Qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 68-dars) **advice**, **information**, **news**, **furniture** kabi so'zlar sanalmasligini ko'rgan edik. O'zbek o'quvchisi uchun bu eng og'riqli mavzulardan biri: o'zbekchada «maslahatlar», «ma'lumotlar», «yangiliklar», «yuklar» bemalol aytiladi, inglizchada esa bu so'zlar `-s` olmaydi va **a / an** bilan ishlatilmaydi. Bu darsda ro'yxatni to'liqroq ko'ramiz, uni mantiqiy guruhlarga ajratamiz va eng muhimi — ularning o'rniga nima deyish kerakligini o'rganamiz.

Nega shunday? Bu so'zlar alohida donani emas, **butun turkum yoki massani** nomlaydi. **furniture** — bitta stul emas, uydagi barcha mebel jamlanmasi; **luggage** — yo'lga olgan hamma narsangiz; **information** — bilimlar oqimi, uni suv kabi «ko'p» yoki «oz» deymiz, lekin sanamaymiz. O'zbekcha `-lar` ham bunday so'zlarda ko'pincha haqiqiy ko'plik emas, «turli-tuman» ma'nosini beradi («ma'lumotlar to'pladik») — shuning uchun tarjimada uni inglizchaga ko'chirmang.

blocks.text: Grammatik oqibatlari hammasida bir xil: **a / an** yo'q, `-s` yo'q, fe'l birlikda (**is / was / has**), olmosh — **it** va **this / that**, miqdor so'zlari — **much**, **little**, **a lot of**, **some**, **any**: How **much** luggage **have** you got? This advice **is** useful — I'll follow **it**.

items.text: Thanks for **the information** — **it** was exactly what I needed.
items.translation: **Ma'lumot** uchun rahmat — aynan menga kerak bo'lgan narsa **edi**.

items.text: There **isn't much furniture** in the flat, so it feels bigger.
items.translation: Kvartirada **mebel ko'p emas**, shuning uchun u kattaroq tuyuladi.

items.text: **Has** there been **any progress** with your visa application?

blocks.text: Bittasini aytish: a piece of, an item of, a bit of, a word of

Bitta dona haqida gapirish kerak bo'lsa, o'lchov so'zi qo'shiladi. Universal variant — **a piece of** (uni qizil kitobda ko'rgansiz). B1–B2 darajada boshqalari ham kerak: **an item of** — rasmiyroq, ro'yxat va e'lonlarda; **a bit of** — so'zlashuvda, «ozgina» ma'nosi bilan; **a word of** — faqat advice, warning, thanks bilan. Ko'plikda `-s` ni o'lchov so'zi oladi, ot emas: **two pieces of** evidence («two pieces of evidences» emas).

rows: advice, information, furniture, evidence, equipment, news, research
luck (a stroke of luck — omadning kulib boqishi)

items.text: My mum gave me **a good piece of advice** before my first interview.
items.translation: Birinchi suhbatimdan oldin onam **yaxshi bir maslahat** berdi.

items.text: Passengers may take **one item of hand luggage** on board.
items.translation: Yo'lovchilar salonga **bitta qo'l yuki** olib kirishi mumkin.

blocks.text: Inglizlar «a piece of» ni o'zbek o'quvchisi o'ylaganchalik ko'p ishlatmaydi. Ko'pincha ular shunchaki **sanaladigan sinonimni** tanlaydi: «three pieces of luggage» o'rniga **three bags**, «a piece of work» o'rniga **a task**. Deyarli har bir sanalmaydigan otning sanaladigan jufti bor — ularni juft-juft qilib yodlang. Shunda «bitta ish», «ikkita sayohat», «uchta maslahat» kabi o'zbekcha fikrlarni ham bemalol ifodalaysiz.

rows: She's got **a job** in a bank. / She's got a lot of **work**.
I've got **two bags**. / I haven't got much **luggage**.
Here are **five tips** for the exam.
There's **a story** about Khiva in the paper.

items.text: I'm looking for **a job**, not just **some work** for the summer.
items.translation: Men faqat yozgi **vaqtinchalik ish** emas, doimiy **ish joyi** qidiryapman.

items.text: **Business travel** is tiring, especially when **each trip** lasts only a day.
items.translation: **Xizmat safarlari** charchatadi, ayniqsa **har bir safar** bor-yo'g'i bir kun davom etsa.

blocks.text: Bu uch so'z o'zbekchada ko'pincha bitta «sayohat» yoki «safar» bo'lib tarjima qilinadi. **travel** — sanalmaydi, umuman sayohat qilish faoliyati: air **travel**, **Travel** is my hobby. **a journey** — bir joydan boshqasiga borish jarayoni, ayniqsa uzoq yo'l: **The journey** to Nukus takes twenty hours by train. **a trip** — borib qaytish, odatda qisqa va maqsadli: **a business trip**, **a day trip** to Chimgan. «a travel» deyilmaydi; ko'plik **travels** faqat «uzoq sayohatlar» ma'nosida, adabiy uslubda uchraydi: He wrote a book about **his travels** in Asia.
Ko'plik bor, lekin ma'nosi boshqa: works, damages, goods

Ba'zi sanalmaydigan otlarning `-s` li shakli ham mavjud, lekin u **boshqa so'z** sifatida ishlaydi. Bu xatoni yashirib qo'yadi: «damages» to'g'ri so'z, lekin «zararlar» degani emas. Shuning uchun lug'atda `-s` li shaklni ko'rsangiz, ma'nosini alohida tekshiring.

rows: asarlar (the works of Navoi); roadworks — yo'l ta'miri

blocks.text: Sifat ham yordam bermaydi — lekin a great help bor

Qizil kitobdagi qoida (What lovely weather! It's good news.) B1–B2 darajada ham kuchda: sifat sanalmaydigan otni sanaladiganga aylantirmaydi. Lekin ba'zi mavhum otlar sifat bilan **a** olishga ruxsat beradi: **a good education**, **a knowledge of** (→ 69-dars), shuningdek turg'un iboralar — **You've been a great help**, **It's a pity**, **It's a shame**, **What a relief!** Ular istisno; advice, information, news, weather, progress, furniture, luggage, work, travel, accommodation, permission bilan esa **a** hech qachon kelmaydi.

items.text: It's **great news** that you got into Edinburgh University!
You've been **a great help** this week — thank you.
items.translation: Bu hafta menga **katta yordam** berdingiz — rahmat.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Can you give me an advice?» → **Can you give me some advice?**; «I have a lot of works» → **I have a lot of work**; «We made a good progress» → **We made good progress**; «I need an accommodation» → **I need accommodation** / **a place to stay**; «Did you get a permission?» → **Did you get permission?**; «How was your travel?» → **How was your trip / journey?**; «three luggages» → **three bags** / **three pieces of luggage**; «The storm made many damages» → **The storm caused a lot of damage**.

Ish tartibi: o'zbekcha so'zda `-lar` bo'lsa ham, avval yuqoridagi ro'yxatni eslang. So'z ro'yxatda bo'lsa, ikki asosiy yo'l bor: 1) **some / a lot of / much** bilan birlikda qoldiring (some advice, a lot of luggage); 2) dona kerak bo'lsa, sanaladigan sinonimga o'ting (a tip, a job, a trip, a bag). «a piece of» — uchinchi, zaxira yo'l.

British va American English: Amerikada **accommodations** (ko'plik) uchraydi, Britaniyada esa faqat **accommodation**. `-s` bilan tugaydigan birlik otlar (news, maths, physics) — 79-dars; **much / little / a lot of** — 87-dars.

rows: The news **is** good. Where's my luggage? — **It's** here.
miqdor: much, little, a lot of
bitta dona: a piece / an item / a bit / a word of
**a piece of** evidence, **an item of** clothing, **a word of** warning
work → **a job**, travel → **a trip**, luggage → **a bag**, scenery → **a view**

examples.title: Words and facts: **advice**, **information**, **evidence**
examples.description: Bilim va xabar bildiruvchi otlar — advice, information, news, evidence, research, knowledge — inglizchada sanalmaydi: a / an va `-s` yo'q.

sentences.text: My tutor gave me **some useful advice** about my dissertation.
sentences.translation: Ilmiy rahbarim dissertatsiyam bo'yicha **foydali maslahatlar** berdi.

sentences.text: Where can I find **information** about student visas for the UK?
sentences.translation: Buyuk Britaniya talaba vizalari haqida **ma'lumotni** qayerdan topsam bo'ladi?

sentences.text: Have you heard **the news**? Kate and Oliver are getting married!
sentences.translation: **Yangilikni** eshitdingmi? Keyt bilan Oliver turmush qurishyapti!

sentences.text: The police haven't found **any evidence** that the driver was using his phone.
sentences.translation: Politsiya haydovchi telefondan foydalanganini tasdiqlovchi **hech qanday dalil** topmadi.

sentences.text: Recent **research** shows that teenagers sleep less than they did ten years ago.
sentences.translation: So'nggi **tadqiqotlar** o'smirlar o'n yil oldingiga qaraganda kamroq uxlashini ko'rsatmoqda.

sentences.text: I don't need **much information** — just the date and the price.
sentences.translation: Menga **ko'p ma'lumot** kerak emas — faqat sana va narx.

sentences.text: Bekzod never listens to **advice**, so he learns everything the hard way.
sentences.translation: Bekzod hech qachon **maslahatga** quloq solmaydi, shuning uchun hamma narsani o'z boshidan o'tkazib o'rganadi.

sentences.text: The **news** about the factory closing **was** a shock for the whole town.
sentences.translation: Zavod yopilishi haqidagi **xabar** butun shahar uchun zarba **bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza's **knowledge** of local customs made her an excellent guide.
sentences.translation: Mahalliy urf-odatlarni **yaxshi bilishi** Dilnozani a'lo darajadagi gidga aylantirdi.

sentences.text: Before you sign anything, get **some legal advice** and ask for **all the information** in writing.
sentences.translation: Biror narsaga imzo chekishdan oldin **yuristdan maslahat** oling va **barcha ma'lumotni** yozma ravishda so'rang.

examples.title: Groups of things: **furniture**, **luggage**, **equipment**
examples.description: Narsalar jamlanmasini bildiruvchi otlar: furniture, luggage / baggage, equipment, rubbish, clothing, jewellery. Ular alohida buyumni emas, butun turkumni nomlaydi.

sentences.text: We sold most of our old **furniture** before we moved to Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga ko'chishdan oldin eski **mebellarimizning** ko'pini sotdik.

sentences.text: How **much luggage** are we allowed to take on this flight?
sentences.translation: Bu reysga **qancha yuk** olishimizga ruxsat bor?

sentences.text: The gym has **new equipment**, but nobody knows how to use it.
sentences.translation: Sport zalida **yangi jihozlar** bor, lekin hech kim ulardan foydalanishni bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Please don't leave **your rubbish** on the beach — take it with you.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **axlatingizni** plyajda qoldirmang — o'zingiz bilan olib keting.

sentences.text: Most of my grandmother's **jewellery** was a gift from my grandfather.
sentences.translation: Buvimning **taqinchoqlari** asosan bobomning sovg'asi edi.

sentences.text: Unattended **baggage** will be removed by security staff.
sentences.translation: Qarovsiz qoldirilgan **yuklar** xavfsizlik xodimlari tomonidan olib ketiladi.

sentences.text: The charity collects warm **clothing** for families in mountain villages.
sentences.translation: Xayriya tashkiloti tog' qishloqlaridagi oilalar uchun issiq **kiyim-kechak** to'playdi.

sentences.text: Is all this **camera equipment** yours? — No, half of it belongs to Jasur.
sentences.translation: Bu **kamera jihozlarining** hammasi senikimi? — Yo'q, yarmi Jasurniki.

sentences.text: Our office **furniture** is cheap and uncomfortable, so my back always hurts.
sentences.translation: Ofisimizdagi **mebel** arzon va noqulay, shuning uchun belim doim og'riydi.

sentences.text: My suitcase got lost in Istanbul, so I arrived in London without **any luggage** at all.
sentences.translation: Chamadonim Istanbulda yo'qolib qoldi, shuning uchun Londonga mutlaqo **yuksiz** yetib keldim.

examples.title: Activities: **work**, **homework**, **travel**, **progress**
examples.description: Faoliyat va jarayonni bildiruvchi otlar: work, homework, travel, progress. «Ishlar», «sayohatlar», «yutuqlar» — inglizchada birlikda va artiklsiz.

sentences.text: I've got **so much work** this week that I can't take a day off.
sentences.translation: Bu hafta **ishim shunchalik ko'pki**, bir kun ham dam ololmayman.

sentences.text: Our son has **two hours of homework** every evening.
sentences.translation: O'g'limizning har oqshom **ikki soatlik uy vazifasi** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **Air travel** has become much cheaper over the last twenty years.
sentences.translation: So'nggi yigirma yilda **samolyotda sayohat** ancha arzonlashdi.

sentences.text: Your English is improving fast — you're making **great progress**!
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilingiz tez yaxshilanyapti — **ancha olg'a ketyapsiz**!

sentences.text: The builders have done **good work**, but the price was too high.
sentences.translation: Quruvchilar **yaxshi ish** qilishdi, lekin narx juda baland bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Peace talks are moving slowly, and there has been **little progress** so far.
sentences.translation: Tinchlik muzokaralari sekin ketyapti, hozircha **deyarli hech qanday siljish** yo'q.

sentences.text: Does the company pay for **travel** to and from the office?
sentences.translation: Kompaniya ofisga borib-kelish **yo'l xarajatini** to'laydimi?

sentences.text: Nilufar finished **her homework** early and went out with her friends.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **uy vazifasini** erta tugatdi va dugonalari bilan sayrga chiqdi.

sentences.text: **Work** on the new bridge will start in March and take two years.
sentences.translation: Yangi ko'prik ustidagi **ishlar** martda boshlanib, ikki yil davom etadi.

sentences.text: Although **foreign travel** is exciting, it can be stressful when you don't speak the language.
sentences.translation: **Chet elga sayohat** qiziqarli bo'lsa ham, tilni bilmasangiz, asabni charchatishi mumkin.

examples.title: Situations: **weather**, **traffic**, **damage**, **behaviour**
examples.description: Holat va hodisa otlari: weather, traffic, damage, behaviour, chaos, accommodation, permission, scenery — sanalmaydi; sifat qo'shilsa ham a / an olmaydi.

sentences.text: We had **awful weather** in Manchester, so we stayed indoors most of the time.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda **ob-havo dahshatli** bo'ldi, shuning uchun ko'pincha uydan chiqmadik.

sentences.text: There's always **heavy traffic** on this road between eight and nine.
sentences.translation: Bu yo'lda soat sakkizdan to'qqizgacha doim **tirbandlik** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The storm caused **serious damage** to houses in the Fergana Valley.
sentences.translation: Bo'ron Farg'ona vodiysidagi uylarga **jiddiy zarar** yetkazdi.

sentences.text: The teacher complained about the boys' **behaviour** during the excursion.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi ekskursiya paytida o'g'il bolalarning **xulqidan** shikoyat qildi.

sentences.text: When the power went off, there was **complete chaos** at the airport.
sentences.translation: Elektr o'chganda aeroportda **to'liq tartibsizlik** boshlandi.

sentences.text: Finding **accommodation** in Oxford is hard and very expensive for students.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda **turar joy** topish talabalar uchun qiyin va juda qimmat.

sentences.text: You need **permission** from your parents to go on the school trip.
sentences.translation: Maktab sayohatiga borish uchun ota-onangizdan **ruxsat** olishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: The **scenery** on the road from Tashkent to Fergana is breathtaking.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Farg'onaga boradigan yo'ldagi **manzaralar** kishini hayratga soladi.

sentences.text: Did the flood do **much damage** to your shop? — Luckily, not much.
sentences.translation: Toshqin do'koningizga **ko'p zarar** yetkazdimi? — Xayriyat, ko'p emas.

sentences.text: Because of **bad weather** and **heavy traffic**, the bus arrived in Bukhara three hours late.
sentences.translation: **Yomon ob-havo** va **tirbandlik** tufayli avtobus Buxoroga uch soat kechikib keldi.

examples.title: One unit: **a piece of**, **an item of**, **a word of**
examples.description: Bittasini aytish uchun o'lchov so'zi: a piece of (eng ko'p), an item of (rasmiyroq), a bit of (so'zlashuvda), a word of (advice / warning bilan).

sentences.text: Here's **a piece of advice** from someone who has made that mistake.
sentences.translation: Mana, o'sha xatoni qilgan odamdan **bitta maslahat**.

sentences.text: Each **item of luggage** must have a label with your name on it.
sentences.translation: **Har bir yuk** ustida ismingiz yozilgan yorliq bo'lishi kerak.

sentences.text: We bought **a beautiful piece of furniture** at the antique market in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi antikvar bozoridan **bitta chiroyli mebel** sotib oldik.

sentences.text: **A bit of luck** and hard work helped Jasur win the competition.
sentences.translation: **Ozgina omad** va mashaqqatli mehnat Jasurga musobaqada g'olib bo'lishga yordam berdi.

sentences.text: The most important **item of news** today is the new tax law.
sentences.translation: Bugungi eng muhim **yangilik** — yangi soliq qonuni.

sentences.text: **A word of warning**: the museum is closed on Mondays.
sentences.translation: **Bir ogohlantirish**: muzey dushanba kunlari yopiq.

sentences.text: The detective found **a vital piece of evidence** under the sofa.
sentences.translation: Tergovchi divan ostidan **muhim bir dalil** topdi.

sentences.text: Could you give me **a bit of help** with these heavy boxes?
sentences.translation: Bu og'ir qutilarni ko'tarishga **ozgina yordam** berib yuborolmaysizmi?

sentences.text: Every **piece of equipment** in the lab is checked before each experiment.
sentences.translation: Laboratoriyadagi **har bir jihoz** har bir tajribadan oldin tekshiriladi.

sentences.text: That was **a useful bit of information** — I didn't know the museum offered free tours for students.
sentences.translation: Bu **foydali ma'lumot** bo'ldi — muzeyda talabalar uchun bepul ekskursiya borligini bilmagan edim.

examples.title: Countable partners: **a job**, **a trip**, **a view**
examples.description: Ko'pincha «a piece of» o'rniga sanaladigan sinonim tabiiyroq: work — a job, travel — a trip / a journey, luggage — a suitcase, accommodation — a room, scenery — a view.

sentences.text: Aziz is looking for **a job** in IT because there's not much **work** in his town.
sentences.translation: Azizning shaharchasida **ish** kam, shuning uchun u IT sohasidan **ish joyi** qidiryapti.

sentences.text: I love **travel**, but **the journey** from Tashkent to Nukus by bus nearly killed me.
sentences.translation: **Sayohatni** yaxshi ko'raman, lekin Toshkentdan Nukusgacha avtobusdagi **yo'l** meni holdan toydirdi.

sentences.text: How was **your trip** to Edinburgh? — Short but fantastic.
sentences.translation: Edinburgga **safaringiz** qanday o'tdi? — Qisqa, lekin ajoyib.

sentences.text: Emma took **one small suitcase** because she hates carrying heavy **luggage**.
sentences.translation: Emma **bitta kichik chamadon** oldi, chunki og'ir **yuk** ko'tarishni yomon ko'radi.

sentences.text: We need **accommodation** for three nights — is **a room** for two still free?
sentences.translation: Bizga uch kechaga **turar joy** kerak — ikki kishilik **xona** hali bo'shmi?

sentences.text: From our hotel there's **a wonderful view** of the mountains, and the **scenery** is amazing.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonamizdan tog'larning **ajoyib ko'rinishi** ochiladi, **manzara** esa hayratlanarli.

sentences.text: Foreign students need **a work permit**, not just **permission** from the university.
sentences.translation: Chet ellik talabalarga universitetning **ruxsati** emas, **ishlash uchun ruxsatnoma** kerak.

sentences.text: Can you give me **a few tips** on preparing for the interview?
sentences.translation: Suhbatga tayyorlanish bo'yicha **bir nechta maslahat** bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: There were **three interesting stories** in today's paper about the new airport.
sentences.translation: Bugungi gazetada yangi aeroport haqida **uchta qiziqarli maqola** bor edi.

sentences.text: She has done **a lot of research** on the topic and published **two studies** in international journals.
sentences.translation: U bu mavzuda **ko'p izlanishlar** olib borgan va xalqaro jurnallarda **ikkita tadqiqotini** chop etgan.

examples.title: Grammar: **is**, **it**, and no **a** with adjectives
examples.description: Sanalmaydigan ot bilan fe'l birlikda (is, was, has), olmosh — it, this; sifat qo'shilsa ham a / an paydo bo'lmaydi: It's good news. What lovely weather!

sentences.text: **The news was** so shocking that nobody could say a word.
sentences.translation: **Xabar** shunchalik dahshatli **ediki**, hech kim og'iz ocha olmadi.

sentences.text: Thanks for the advice about the landlord — **it was** really helpful.
sentences.translation: Uy egasi haqidagi maslahatingiz uchun rahmat — juda **asqotdi**.

sentences.text: Where's your luggage? — **It's** still on the plane, unfortunately.
sentences.translation: Yukingiz qani? — Afsuski, **u** hali ham samolyotda.

sentences.text: That's **wonderful news** — congratulations on your new job!
sentences.translation: Bu **ajoyib yangilik** — yangi ishingiz bilan tabriklayman!

sentences.text: What **lovely weather**! Shall we have lunch in the garden?
sentences.translation: **Ob-havo** qanday **ajoyib**! Tushlikni bog'da qilamizmi?

sentences.text: **This information is** out of date, so please don't rely on it.
sentences.translation: **Bu ma'lumot eskirgan**, iltimos, unga tayanmang.

sentences.text: My cousin gave me **some very good advice** about renting a flat in London.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham Londonda kvartira ijaraga olish haqida **juda yaxshi maslahat** berdi.

sentences.text: Your **progress** this term **has been** excellent, Madina.
sentences.translation: Madina, bu chorakda **o'zlashtirishing a'lo bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Is there **any news** from the hospital? — Not yet, the doctors are still operating.
sentences.translation: Kasalxonadan **biror xabar** bormi? — Hali yo'q, shifokorlar hali ham operatsiya qilishyapti.

sentences.text: The new furniture looks great, but **it** cost twice as much as we had planned.
sentences.translation: Yangi **mebel** chiroyli ko'rinyapti, lekin **u** biz rejalashtirgandan ikki baravar qimmatga tushdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: checking in at a London hotel
examples.description: Mehmonxonada: accommodation, luggage, information, advice, traffic, weather, news, work — hammasi sanalmaydi, lekin trip sanaladi.

sentences.text: — Good evening, I booked **accommodation** for two nights under the name Karimov.
sentences.translation: — Xayrli kech, Karimov nomiga ikki kechaga **turar joy** band qilgan edim.

sentences.text: — Welcome! Can I see your passport? And is this all your **luggage**?
sentences.translation: — Xush kelibsiz! Pasportingizni ko'rsam bo'ladimi? **Yukingiz** shumi?

sentences.text: — Yes, just one suitcase — I always travel light on **business trips**.
sentences.translation: — Ha, bitta chamadon — **xizmat safarlarida** doim yengil yuraman.

sentences.text: — Perfect. Here's your key and **some information** about the hotel.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Mana kalitingiz va mehmonxona haqida **ma'lumot**.

sentences.text: — Thank you. Could you give me **some advice** on getting to Oxford tomorrow?
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Ertaga Oksfordga qanday borish bo'yicha **maslahat** bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: — The train is best, because **the traffic** on the motorway is awful in the mornings.
sentences.translation: — Poyezd eng yaxshisi, chunki ertalab avtomagistralda **tirbandlik** dahshatli bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — Good to know. Is **the weather** going to be nice, do you know?
sentences.translation: — Bilganim yaxshi bo'ldi. **Ob-havo** yaxshi bo'larmikin, bilmaysizmi?

sentences.text: — I'm afraid there's **bad news**: rain all day, according to the forecast.
sentences.translation: — Afsuski, **xabar yomon**: prognozga ko'ra, kun bo'yi yomg'ir.

sentences.text: — Never mind, I'm going there for **work**, not for sightseeing.
sentences.translation: — Mayli, u yerga **ish** bilan boryapman, sayr qilgani emas.

sentences.text: — Then I wish you **a successful trip** and a pleasant evening!
sentences.translation: — Unda **safaringiz** muvaffaqiyatli o'tsin, oqshomingiz xush o'tsin!
